<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula C₆H₁₀N₂O matches this mass (exact mass 126.0793 Da) within typical experimental error and fits the observed simple isotopic pattern (no halogen or metal isotopes). Therefore the molecular formula is C6H10N2O.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10N2O</final_answer>
